name: Métropole Télévision S.A.
summary: Métropole Télévision S.A. operates as a multimedia group in France. It operates through Video, Audio, Production and Audiovisual Rights, and Diversification segments. The company operates free-to-air channels, including M6, W9, 6TER, and Gulli; pay channels, such as Paris Première, Téva, sérieclub, M6 Music, MCM Top, Canal J, Tiji, and RFM TV; non-linear TV comprising M6+, M6+ Max, Gulli Max, and Gulli Replay; and production of current affairs magazines, such as Capital, Zone Interdite, Enquête Exclusive, 66 Minutes, Turbo, Un jour, Undoc, W9, and 6ter.
